user.title: Connect to Marstek Battery System
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Marstek device.

data_description.max_passive_power: The highest charge/discharge power your device actually supports. Passive-mode commands are clamped to this range, or to your model's own known limit if that is lower.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the IP address and ensure the Open API is enabled in the Marstek app.
error.invalid_identity: The device did not return a valid BLE MAC address. Please try again when the device is ready.
